set.body:
Scheduling lane: maintenance. Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19: Retain the incomplete intake-review scope as a bounded cold review of A-C. The current planning review does not certify the missing findings.

Historical finding and scope retained below; current acceptance ownership above governs.

The post-fix cold review of the three risky intake slices (agent cold-slices-postfix, 2026-09-17/18) arrived in truncated instalments, and three parts never came:
- MINOR A3 (referenced three times, never sent)
- the remainder of finding C1 (cut off at "SherlockAnnotations.scala:14-15 claims the adapter replays exactly tha...")
- the closing "what I would refuse to merge" verdict.

Retrieve them: SendMessage to the agent if its session is live, otherwise re-run a cold review scoped to slices A-C at HEAD. File anything new. Everything that was delivered has been acted on; see the "Second cold review" section of docs/plans/2026-09-17-intake-contract-evidence.md.
set.title: [maintenance] Retrieve the undelivered remainder of the post-fix cold review: MINOR A3, the rest of C1, the refuse-to-merge verdict
